supplement.evidence: All species identification, bioassay, and genotype data are fully reported in Tables 1-3 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and target-site resistance markers (Vgsc L1014F and Ace-1 G119S) in Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii reared from larval collections in irrigated vegetable farms in Asokwa submetropolis, Kumasi, Ghana. High frequencies of the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) mutation were detected in both species (61% in An. gambiae s.s., 91% in An. coluzzii), while the Ace-1 G119S (G280S) mutation was absent.
